metadata.title: Top 10 Private Universities in Bangladesh
metadata.cost_basis: Estimated total undergraduate degree cost (tuition and typical academic fees where included by the source)
metadata.ranking_note: This is a practical shortlist, not an official UGC ranking. University order follows a 2026 comparison article; rankings vary by publisher and methodology.
metadata.cost_note: Department-level figures are indicative total-program planning estimates in BDT, not verified official quotations. They are approximate ranges and may differ from each university's current published fee schedule. Actual cost depends on credit requirements, admission fees, lab/studio fees, semester charges, retakes, waivers and scholarships. Confirm each department's current fee breakdown directly with the university before making a decision.

metadata.department_cost_methodology: Department estimates are differentiated by programme type and likely lab/studio intensity, while staying within the university-level cost bands in this dataset. They should be treated as preliminary estimates, not exact official fees.
